def pearson(xs, ys):
    nn=len(xs)
    mx=statistics.mean(xs); my=statistics.mean(ys)
    sx=sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs)
    sy=sum((y-my)**2 for y in ys)
    if sx == 0 or sy == 0:
        return None
    return sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))/math.sqrt(sx*sy)

cols=[[row[j] for row in values] for j in range(p)]
matrix=[]
for i in range(p):
    row=[]
    for j in range(p):
        if i==j:
            coef=1.0 if len(set(cols[i]))>1 else None
        else:
            coef=pearson(cols[i], cols[j])
        if coef is not None and not math.isfinite(coef):
            coef=None
        row.append(coef)
    matrix.append(row)

matrix
